project.name: VendorIQ
project.descriptor: An AI-driven job-seeker protection platform that tracks recruiter and vendor behavior patterns over time.

guardrails.statement: The system must ensure data is correctly attributed to the right recruiter.
The system must support manual data review to ensure completeness and correctness.
The system must ensure data is clean before ingestion.

requirements.statement: The system must ingest recruiter interaction data from a CSV/XLSX file.
The system must display a dashboard showing recruiter interaction history to job seekers.
The system must highlight red flags in recruiter interactions for manual review.
The system must allow job seekers to manually verify data accuracy before displaying it.
The system must flag uncertain data for manual review without making automated judgments.
The system must provide clear explanations of displayed data to job seekers.
The system must ensure data is correctly attributed to the right recruiter.
Every screen the job seeker uses must complete its primary action in three clicks or fewer.
The system must not integrate with Gmail, Outlook, LinkedIn, Slack, CRM systems, or ATS systems.
The system must support manual data review to ensure completeness and correctness.
The system must display message frequency and timestamps in the dashboard.
The system must show whether replies occurred in recruiter interactions.
The system must allow job seekers to see responsiveness and follow-up patterns.
The system must ensure data is clean before ingestion.
The system must not score or judge recruiter behavior automatically.
The system must provide a trial period with real users to ensure reliability.
The system must gather positive user feedback to confirm reliability and ease of use.
The system must maintain a log of manual reviews for audit purposes.

stories.title: Ingest recruiter interaction data from CSV/XLSX
stories.narrative: As a job seeker, I want to upload my recruiter interaction history as a CSV or XLSX file so that the system has my data to work with.

stories.title: Display recruiter interaction history on dashboard
stories.narrative: As a job seeker, I want to see my recruiter interaction history on a dashboard so that I can review it in one place.

stories.title: Manual verification of data accuracy and attribution
stories.narrative: As a data reviewer, I want to manually verify that ingested data is accurate and attributed to the correct recruiter so that job seekers see trustworthy information.

stories.title: Ensure data is clean before ingestion
stories.narrative: As a system administrator, I want incoming data cleaned before it is ingested so that downstream processing is not corrupted by malformed records.

stories.title: Highlight red flags in recruiter interactions
stories.narrative: As a job seeker, I want red flags in recruiter interactions highlighted so that I know what to look at more closely.

stories.title: Flag uncertain data for manual review
stories.narrative: As a data reviewer, I want uncertain data flagged for manual review instead of automatically judged so that no automated decision is made without a human check.

stories.title: Support manual data review for completeness and correctness
stories.narrative: As a data reviewer, I want to manually review flagged data for completeness and correctness so that only trustworthy information reaches job seekers.

stories.title: Display message frequency and timestamps
stories.narrative: As a job seeker, I want to see message frequency and timestamps for each recruiter interaction so that I can judge how active the relationship is.

stories.title: Provide clear explanations of displayed data
stories.narrative: As a job seeker, I want clear explanations of the data shown to me so that I understand what I am looking at without guessing.

stories.title: Display recruiter interaction reply status
stories.narrative: As a job seeker, I want to see whether a recruiter interaction received a reply so that I can judge how responsive the recruiter has been.

stories.title: Show job seekers recruiter responsiveness and follow-up patterns
stories.narrative: As a job seeker, I want to see a recruiter's responsiveness and follow-up patterns so that I can decide how much to trust future outreach from them.

stories.title: Collect user feedback during trial period
stories.narrative: As a product manager, I want to collect feedback from job seekers during a trial period so that I know whether the system is actually useful to them.

stories.title: Ensure positive user feedback confirms reliability
stories.narrative: As a product manager, I want positive trial feedback to confirm the system's reliability so that I have evidence the system is ready beyond the trial group.

stories.title: Maintain a log of manual reviews for audit purposes
stories.narrative: As a compliance officer, I want a log of every manual review kept for audit purposes so that the review process can be inspected after the fact.
